live_bindings.replacement: Reuse a vetted geology background/stone texture only if it can be mounted without obscuring path ownership; otherwise refine procedural cells with restrained authored texture and a current runtime capture. Do not score 4.5 until viewed in the live mode.

live_bindings.art: geologist_fossil.svg plus magic_cleaning_brush.png; fossil uses a 256x256 vector expanded into a 560x300 panel and 3 piece regions
live_bindings.score_type: unscored live vector; raster brush inspected
live_bindings.observed_risk: The vector source was not raster-viewed by the available image viewer. The source is a compact 256px SVG and its runtime enlargement, alpha contour, and piece seams require current capture review. The brush raster is polished and coherent, but its 936x1024 canvas is much larger than the 156px runtime draw box, so contact alignment and downsample readability need runtime evidence.
live_bindings.replacement: Keep the approved brush; capture brush contact and fossil clear/assemble states. If the vector fossil reads thin or flat at runtime, prefer an approved clean painted fossil source before generation.

live_bindings.observed_risk: Source fact: the pan fallback is built from an ellipse, grain dots, arcs, and generated mineral polygons; no pan texture path or handle/soil art is bound. Rendered quality and any 4.5 threshold result require a current capture.
live_bindings.replacement: Inventory an approved clean pan/mineral source first. The reviewed six-object candidate is visually suitable but rejected because it is RGB with baked checkerboard and 1254x1254 rather than runtime-ready alpha; do not bind it directly.

live_bindings.art: Procedural split geode halves plus goal_geologist.svg crystal insert
live_bindings.observed_risk: Source fact: the shell is generated from purple polygons with a heavy outline and straight seam, and opening is represented by horizontal pull geometry rather than a bound painted split. The crystal insert is live but was not raster-viewed here. Rendered readability and art quality require a current capture.
live_bindings.replacement: Use a clean approved paired closed/open geode source if available, preserving seam hit spots and pull geometry. The reviewed painted candidate has strong visual quality but is rejected RGB checkerboard art and cannot be reused without a separately approved alpha derivation.
